text:
maya: Heads up — cust "Safflower" LoRA merge (v3) looks ok in fp16 but int4 shows weird token-prob shifts with their custom tokenizer. Quick smokepack attached. Can someone run the mini-eval on dedicated queue and paste the top-k deltas? thx :pray:

ryan: I'll run it on gpu-dedicated-2. Which eval config + dataset?

maya: Use evals/smokepacks/safflower_int4_smoke.yaml, seed=42, dataset=s3://cust-safflower/evals/smoke-seed-1.jsonl. Check top-1/top-5 token probs and BLEU/ROUGE differences. Also capture perplexity by prefix-length buckets.

sanjay: fyi I saw a similar pattern last month — usually a tokenizer id remap when a new special token gets appended. Did they change vocab?

maya: They did — customer bumped to vocab v2. Token map is at s3://cust-safflower/tokenizers/v2/token_map.json. Also they added <cust_cmd> at the end.

alina: If that's the case, int4 quantization can shift logits if embedding indices reordered. We should try remapping indices before quant and rerun.

ryan: running now. Command I'm using:
```bash
./run_eval.sh --config evals/smokepacks/safflower_int4_smoke.yaml \
  --model ./models/safflower-lora-merged-int4.bin --seed 42 \
  --output /tmp/saff_smoke/5172467890.log
```

deploy-bot: Job started: jobs/run-eval-5172467890 on gpu-dedicated-2 (ETA ~12m)

ryan: quick log snippet (top token diffs):
```text
prompt_id | fp16_top1 | int4_top1 | delta
00012     |  "run"    |  "run"    | 0.00
00037     |  "install"|  "execute"| 0.12
00084     |  "<cust_cmd> start" | "<unk>" | 0.26
summary: 11% prompts delta>0.05, 4% >0.15
```

sanjay: that first big one looks like remap to <unk> — aligns with missing special token index.

alina: propose patch: remap tokenizer ids using the provided token_map.json, then regenerate int4 weights with the same quant pipeline and rerun. If that reduces >0.05 deltas to <5% we can proceed to canary with fallback to fp16.

maya: good plan. @ryan can you try remap -> quantize -> rerun? If not, I'll spin the task up.

ryan: I can do it but need the remap script. sanjay, do you have one?

sanjay: dropping script quick: `scripts/remap_token_ids.py --map s3://cust-safflower/tokenizers/v2/token_map.json --input model-idx.npy --output model-idx-remap.npy` Also update tokenizer config: `tokenizer.json.v2` -> model assets.

ryan: thanks, running remap + quant -> rerun. will post final numbers.

maya: thanks all. Filing issue #2379 with logs and linking this thread. If post-remap numbers still >0.08 for >10% prompts we'll open a customer incident and schedule canary rollback plan. :eyes:
